scheme_name: Residential- Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya/ Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya
description:
The Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya Scheme was launched in 1986. 

It was initiated by the Government of India under the Ministry of Education. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide quality education to children from rural areas. 

The scheme aims to ensure that talented children from economically weaker sections have access to quality education. 

The Navodaya Vidyalayas are co-educational residential schools. 

They are affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education. 

The schools offer education from Class VI to Class XII. 

The Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalayas are spread across the country. 

As of October 2023, there are 661 Navodaya Vidyalayas in India. 

These schools are established in each district of the country. 

The selection of students is done through a competitive entrance examination. 

The entrance exam is conducted for admission to Class VI. 

The examination is held annually in the month of January. 

The objective of the entrance exam is to identify talented students. 

Students from rural areas are given priority in the selection process. 

The benefits of the scheme include free education for selected students. 

This includes free boarding and lodging facilities. 

Students receive free textbooks and uniforms. 

The scheme also provides a monthly stipend for students. 

As of 2023, the stipend amount is INR 600 per month. 

The scheme aims to promote national integration. 

It encourages students from different backgrounds to interact and learn together. 

The Navodaya Vidyalayas follow a unique curriculum. 

The curriculum is designed to promote holistic development. 

Students are encouraged to participate in extracurricular activities. 

This includes sports, arts, and cultural programs. 

The eligibility criteria for admission are specific. 

Students must be between the ages of 9 to 13 years. 

They must be studying in Class V in a recognized school. 

There is no income limit for eligibility. 

However, preference is given to students from rural areas. 

The application process for admission is straightforward. 

Parents or guardians must fill out an application form. 

The application form can be obtained from the official website. 

The completed form must be submitted before the deadline. 

The deadline for submission is usually in the month of December. 

Admit cards for the entrance exam are issued in January. 

The entrance examination is conducted in February. 

Results are declared within a month after the examination. 

Selected students are called for counseling sessions. 

Counseling sessions are held in March or April. 

The academic session begins in April. 

The implementing authority for the scheme is the Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti. 

The Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti operates under the Ministry of Education. 

The headquarters of the Samiti is located in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. 

The contact number for the Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti is 0120-2405968. 

The official website provides comprehensive information about the scheme. 

The website URL is www.nvsadmissionclasssix.in. 

The Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya Scheme was launched in 2020. 

It aims to provide quality education to underprivileged children. 

The scheme focuses on enhancing educational opportunities for marginalized communities. 

The Abhinav Vidyalayas are designed to be inclusive. 

They cater to children from economically weaker sections. 

The objective is to bridge the educational gap in society. 

The scheme emphasizes skill development and vocational training. 

Students are provided with resources to enhance their learning experience. 

The Abhinav Vidyalayas are also co-educational and residential. 

They follow the National Education Policy guidelines. 

The eligibility criteria for the Abhinav Vidyalaya Scheme are similar. 

Children must be between the ages of 6 to 14 years. 

They must belong to economically weaker sections. 

The application process is similar to that of the Navodaya Vidyalayas. 

Parents can apply online through the official portal. 

The application must be submitted within the specified timeframe. 

The Abhinav Vidyalayas aim to promote inclusive education. 

They focus on providing a safe and nurturing environment for children. 

The curriculum includes academic subjects as well as life skills. 

Students are encouraged to participate in community service. 

The scheme also aims to promote digital literacy among students. 

The government allocates specific funds for the implementation of these schemes. 

The funding is aimed at infrastructure development and teacher training. 

The Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya Scheme has significantly impacted rural education. 

It has provided opportunities for thousands of children across India. 

The success of the scheme can be measured by the number of students enrolled. 

In the academic year 2022-2023, over 2.5 million students were enrolled in Navodaya Vidyalayas. 

The scheme has also received recognition for its innovative approach to education. 

The Rajiv Gandhi Abhinav Vidyalaya Scheme complements the existing educational framework. 

It addresses the needs of underprivileged children effectively. 

Both schemes are crucial for achieving the goal of universal education in India. 

They reflect the government's commitment to improving educational standards. 

The overall impact of these schemes is evident in the improved literacy rates. 

The schemes have contributed to the empowerment of marginalized communities. 

They have fostered a sense of equality in educational opportunities. 

The Rajiv Gandhi Navodaya Vidyalaya and Abhinav Vidyalaya Schemes are vital for the future of education in India. 

They are instrumental in shaping the lives of countless children. 

The government continues to monitor and evaluate these schemes regularly. 

This ensures that they meet the evolving needs of society. 

The commitment to quality education remains a priority for the Indian government.
